provenance.note: Initial pins were generated from llvm-project main (upstream, not ROCm), fetched 2026-11-12, commit unknown. docs/CHECK.md names ROCm llvm-project d6f6cb69 as the basis of AMDGPUWaitSGPRHazards / SIInsertWaitcnts; these pins are NOT from that commit. Regenerate them on the Radiance machine with `radisa drift --llvm-src <ROCm llvm-project> --update --revision d6f6cb69` and review the rules of every fact the update reports as changed. Facts the given tree lacks make --update refuse (exit 3, nothing written); re-anchor them by editing file / alt_files / anchor in this JSON (features.* already fall back to AMDGPU.td, where ROCm d6f6cb69 and older trees define FeatureISAVersion12 / FeatureGFX12), then rerun with --note to record what the new pins are.

normalisation: radisa.drift.normalize: comments removed, string/char literals kept verbatim, whitespace dropped except one space between adjacent word tokens; sha256 over UTF-8.

facts.note: Feature set of gfx1201 (GCNProcessors.td GFX1201 uses FeatureISAVersion12.Features). Rules read: FeatureVcmpxPermlaneHazard (PERMLANE_AFTER_CMPX), FeatureMaxHardClauseLength32 (CLAUSE_TOO_LONG), FeatureWaitsBeforeSystemScopeStores (SYS_STORE_WAIT), FeatureD16Writes32BitVgpr (MISSING_WAIT D16 halves), Feature1536VGPRs (VGPR_OUT_OF_RANGE), FeaturePackedTID / FeatureArchitectedSGPRs (UNINITIALIZED_READ entry state), FeatureBackOffBarrier (LDS_STORE_BEFORE_BARRIER). A new *Hazard feature here means LLVM fixes a new hazard on gfx1201: consider a new rule.
Generation features implied for every GFX12 target, incl. FeatureGFX12Insts (hasVALUReadSGPRHazard, isGFX12Plus branches of fixWMMAHazards), FeatureVOPDInsts, FeatureMaxHardClauseLength32.
gfx1201 processor model: speed model and feature list it is built from. A change here can affect every rule.
Gates AMDGPUWaitSGPRHazards (s_wait_alu insertion); currently HasGFX12Insts && !HasGFX1250Insts, true for gfx1201.
SIInsertWaitcnts emits s_nop 0 before s_sendmsg MSG_DEALLOC_VGPRS when true; currently !HasGFX1250Insts, true for gfx1201.
Currently HasGFX1250Insts, false for gfx1201; no radisa rule depends on it. If it becomes true for gfx1201, LLVM requires s_wait_idle before s_getreg and a new rule is needed.
Currently HasGFX1250Insts && GFX12, false for gfx1201; no radisa rule. If it becomes true for gfx1201, LLVM inserts v_nops after s_setreg of MODE and a new rule is needed.
Currently GFX11 only, false for gfx1201; no radisa rule. If it covers GFX12, fixVALUPartialForwardingHazard applies and a new rule is needed.
Currently GFX11 only, false for gfx1201; no radisa rule. If it covers GFX12, fixVALUMaskWriteHazard applies and a new rule is needed.

Currently GFX11+, true for gfx1201: gates fixLdsDirectVALUHazard / fixLdsDirectVMEMHazard in fixHazards. No radisa rule models the LDS-direct hazards yet (not checked); add the rule name here when one exists.
The list of hazard fixers LLVM runs after scheduling and the predicates gating each. A new or re-gated fixer that applies to gfx1201 is a hazard no radisa rule checks.
GFX12 branch: WMMA/SWMMAC D feeding the next A/B (and SWMMAC index) needs one V_NOP.
v_cmpx writing EXEC followed by v_permlane*: LLVM inserts v_mov_b32 vN, vN; which instructions separate them.
Static helper called by fixVcmpxPermlaneHazards: the opcodes LLVM treats as the v_permlane* side of the hazard (the set PERMLANE_AFTER_CMPX must match).
Static helper called by fixVcmpxPermlaneHazards: which instructions count as the EXEC-writing v_cmpx side of the hazard (VOPC, or a VOP3/SDWA compare, that modifies EXEC).
The whole pass that sgpr.py mirrors (tracked SGPRs, VA_SDST/VA_VCC/SA_SDST counters, merge at joins, callee entry, wait encoding). Any change needs sgpr.py re-reviewed.
D16 / true16 halves: when a 16-bit load result shares the 32-bit VGPR with the other half (waits.py d16 handling).
Where SIInsertWaitcnts::run puts s_alloc_vgpr 0 (dynamic VGPRs) or s_nop 0 + s_sendmsg MSG_DEALLOC_VGPRS before s_endpgm, and the condition under which it does.
Hard clause formation (clause types, mixed load/store clauses, length limit, basic-block scope). The task named it AMDGPUInsertHardClauses.cpp; the upstream file is SIInsertHardClauses.cpp.
Waits LLVM inserts before system-scope stores on GFX12.0 (memorder.py).
Called by SIGfx12CacheControl::finalizeStore: the exact s_wait_*cnt list (LOADCNT, SAMPLECNT/BVHCNT if image/BVH instructions exist, KMCNT, STORECNT) that memorder.py SYS_STORE_WAIT restates.
